metaTitle: Custom Multi Color Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom multi color drawstring backpacks for your next event. Great for schools, teams, and giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Multi color drawstring backpacks let you combine your brand colors in one practical giveaway. Use a two-tone design with your logo on the front panel, or choose a rainbow palette for a vibrant look at summer camps and school orientations. Nylon and polyester options hold up to daily use, and screen printing or embroidery keeps your mark visible. These bags pack flat for easy storage and distribution at trade shows or registration desks.
heroAltText: Custom multi color drawstring backpacks in various color combinations with printed logos, perfect for promotional events.
